key_insight: LLM-guided feature optimization improves fleet-scale ranking models while respecting shared feature-pipeline budgets and per-model serving constraints.
engineering_relevance: The system provides a practical workflow for improving ranking quality without exceeding infrastructure cost or serving-throughput limits.
method: LLM agents propose and shortlist cross features; deterministic tools run experiments and verify hypotheses.
Blend multiple feature-importance rankings, using Pareto fronts for multi-task models.
Tune feature selection through 10–25 asynchronous trials per model, then trim features to meet pipeline budgets.
evidence_signal: Across production models, average normalized entropy improved by 0.31% within budget; trimming reduced pipeline cost by 2.3% without regression beyond measurement noise, and online A/B tests improved a primary metric by 0.20%.
watch_item: The abstract does not specify fleet size, evaluation duration, or experiment overhead, limiting assessment of generalizability and net operational savings.
paper_title: Cost-Aware Agentic Feature Optimization System for Fleet-Scale Ranking Models
